description: Find and compare AI models (LLMs) by price per 1M tokens, context window, input/output types and features, from models.dev data refreshed daily. Default: major model makers (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, xAI, DeepSeek, Mistral and others); scope=direct: every model maker; provider: one provider incl. hosts and routers such as openrouter. Returns model ids, prices, context, release date, the provider material id, and a link to the comparison page on the codeitso website.

include_deprecated.description: Include models whose support has ended.

inputs.description: Input types every result must accept besides text.

max_input_price.description: Max input price, USD per 1M tokens.

max_output_price.description: Max output price, USD per 1M tokens.

outputs.description: Output types every result must produce, e.g. image.

query.description: Words in the model name or id, e.g. 'claude sonnet', 'gemini flash'.

response_format.description: 'json' for structured output; default compact markdown.

scope.description: Without provider: 'major' or 'direct' (every company that makes its own models).

sort.description: 'newest', cheapest first by 'input_price' or 'output_price', or largest 'context'.

name: codeitso_find_models
title: 코드잇소 AI 모델 찾기
